description: Check, start, stop or restart one supported Homebrew web service on the selected Mac. status is read-only; stop and restart interrupt the service. Changes run only if the owner allowed changes on that Mac, and may wait for the owner's approval there. In an unattended run, set queue_for_approval (with reason and observed) so the owner can approve later and the Mac runs it.

action.description: status only reads; the others change the service.

mac_id.description: Opaque id of one of this account's FrontierStack Macs. Optional only when exactly one Mac is online.

observed.description: With queue_for_approval: what you saw that led to it (for example the health result).

queue_for_approval.description: For unattended runs (scheduled or background tasks): instead of running now, queue this start, stop or restart for the owner, who approves it on their phone or Mac; FrontierStack then re-checks and runs it itself. Answers at once with the queued request; do not call again.

reason.description: With queue_for_approval: why the change is needed, in a sentence the owner reads before approving.

name: service_action
title: Control a supported web service
